t: You're looking at the Royal Central School of Speech and Drama, usually called Central, a drama school and a constituent college of the University of London. Elsie Fogerty founded it in 1906 as the Central School of Speech Training and Dramatic Art. She was dissatisfied with the elocution of her day, which concentrated on the mouth and nose. Her approach brought in the whole body, because she found that posture and movement affect speech. It became known as the Body and Voice technique. She led the school as principal until 1942.
